paragraphs.source_en: As they approached the familiar shrine gate, Motoyasu caught sight from afar of the white-haired Katō Zusho-no-suke, and his eyes immediately grew moist.

units.source_en: As they approached the familiar shrine gate, Motoyasu caught sight from afar of the white-haired Katō Zusho-no-suke, and his eyes immediately grew moist.
units.source_zh: 来到他们熟悉的神社大门前，元康远远望见白发苍苍的加藤图书助的身影时，眼角顿时湿润了。

paragraphs.source_zh: 来到他们熟悉的神社大门前，元康远远望见白发苍苍的加藤图书助的身影时，眼角顿时湿润了。

paragraphs.source_en: A woman stood beside Zusho-no-suke. When Motoyasu saw that she was his own mother, Odai, whom Nobunaga had invited from Agui Castle under the pretext of a pilgrimage to Atsuta Shrine, he nearly burst into tears.

units.source_en: A woman stood beside Zusho-no-suke.
units.source_zh: 一个女人和图书助并肩而立。

units.source_en: When Motoyasu saw that she was his own mother, Odai, whom Nobunaga had invited from Agui Castle under the pretext of a pilgrimage to Atsuta Shrine, he nearly burst into tears.
units.source_zh: 当元康看到她就是被信长以参拜热田神社之名，从阿古居城请来的亲生母亲於大时，顿时几欲大哭。

paragraphs.source_zh: 一个女人和图书助并肩而立。当元康看到她就是被信长以参拜热田神社之名，从阿古居城请来的亲生母亲於大时，顿时几欲大哭。

paragraphs.source_en: Motoyasu leapt steadily down from his horse and walked toward his mother, Odai.

units.source_en: Motoyasu leapt steadily down from his horse and walked toward his mother, Odai.
units.source_zh: 元康稳稳地从马背上跳下，向母亲於大走去。

paragraphs.source_zh: 元康稳稳地从马背上跳下，向母亲於大走去。
